name: PJBUMI
recent: PJBumi 于2026年11月20日与 Macquarie Bank 签订认购协议，后者将认购最多820万股配售股份（占已发行股份10%）。此前公司于10月获 Bursa 批准一拆五拆股计划，并拟进行最高10%的私募配售。最新财报（2026年6月30日止季度）营收和净利均大幅增长。
notable: 与 Macquarie Bank 签订认购协议，涉及最多820万股配售股份（占已发行股份10%）。
Bursa 于2026年10月批准一拆五拆股计划。
拟进行最高10%已发行股份的私募配售，筹资约3100万令吉。
risks: 私募配售最多10%新股可能摊薄现有股东权益。
拆股计划尚待股东大会通过，存在执行不确定性。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为213.5万令吉，环比增长53.6%，同比增长907.1%；净利为110.9万令吉，环比增长746.6%，净利率从9.4%升至51.9%。

recent_en: On 20 November 2026, PJBumi entered into a subscription agreement with Macquarie Bank for up to 8.2 million placement shares (10% of issued shares). Earlier, the company obtained Bursa approval in October for a 1-into-5 share split and proposed a private placement of up to 10%. The latest quarterly results (period ended 30 June 2026) showed significant growth in revenue and net profit.
notable_en: Signed a subscription agreement with Macquarie Bank for up to 8.2 million placement shares (10% of issued shares).
Bursa approved the proposed 1-into-5 share split in October 2026.
Proposed a private placement of up to 10% of issued shares to raise approximately RM31 million.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
The share split is subject to shareholder approval at the AGM, with execution uncertainty.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2.135 million, up 53.6% QoQ and 907.1% YoY; net profit was RM1.109 million, up 746.6% QoQ, with net margin rising from 9.4% to 51.9%.
